cim: AI is already saving lives on our roads, rails, and runways
cim_eredeti: AI is already saving lives on our roads, rails, and runways
szoveg_eredeti:
‘Now, Not Someday’ is an op-ed series in partnership with Independent Women, in which five leading experts discuss how artificial intelligence and data centers are saving lives and helping families in every major industry.

Somewhere in America today, a car will automatically brake and avoid the vehicle in front of it. The driver may never realize how close he came. That quiet save is the work of artificial intelligence, and it is happening now on our roads, rails, and runways.

prioritas.cim_hu: Véleménycikk jelent meg arról, hogyan ment életet az AI a közlekedésben
prioritas.lead_hu: Egy új cikksorozatban szakértők mutatják be, miként előzik meg a baleseteket az AI-alapú vezetéstámogató rendszerek. A technológia az utakon, a vasúton és a légi közlekedésben is jelen van.
